properties.text: Local NED z stays at or above -2.0 m, i.e. the altitude above the local origin stays at or below the 2.0 m ceiling of the M2 bench scenario. z is down-positive. The ceiling is deliberately below the PX4 takeoff altitude (MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT, 2.5 m by default) so that the run contains both verdicts: not violated on the ground and during the first part of the climb, violated after the ceiling is crossed. A requirement that is violated from the first sample makes AC-3 vacuous (review of 2026-09-11, AC-3 gap).
